# Pinnacle Verification Centre

> Source-led evidence for Pinnacle Blooms Network and Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited.

Source review: 15 September 2026. Selected originals and review conclusions rechecked: 18 September 2026. This site summarizes documentary evidence and is not a regulator’s certification service. Preserve the review status and scope limits when citing a record. A protocol is not completed validation; a management-system certificate does not guarantee a child’s outcome. Source review does not establish endorsement by the issuing organisations.

Contact: Gokul Rao · care@pinnacleblooms.org · +91 9100 181 181.

## Reference files

- [Plain-text evidence](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/llms-full.txt): full record summaries with limitations.
- [Evidence JSON](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/evidence.json): the same records as structured data.

- [Family meaning and global context](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/global-context.html): selected comparisons and international guidance.
- [Global context JSON](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/global-context.json): references, scope and comparison definitions.

- [Complete HFR register](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/hfr-register.html): all 52 workbook centres; 53 distinct IDs across source sets.
